usage: Used as a common noun for an animal: 牛 refers to a cow, and it is a very basic everyday word.
Often appears in animal-related contexts, farm vocabulary, and simple descriptions of animals.
Can also be used in compound words and set phrases, so learners should recognise it as a building block in common Cantonese vocabulary.
When talking about the animal, 牛 is neutral and natural in spoken Hong Kong Cantonese.
